FR:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Chapeau !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}Cuisiner demande plus de
talent et d'énergie que c'que les
gens ont tendance à imaginer !
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Perso{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Mes proches m'appellent au
secours à chaque fois qu'il y a un
festin à préparer,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Ma dai!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}} Cucinare richiede molta
più capacità e forza di quanto
la gente pensi!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Io{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} vengo sempre chiamata a casa
nei periodi di festa, per cimentarmi
con qualche ricetta, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}İşte bu!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}} Yemek yapmak
insanların sandığından daha çok
beceri ve güç ister!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Ben{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
bayramlarda aile yemeğini
kurtarayım diye hep eve
çağrılırım, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Ooh!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Good for you!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}} I always get
called home around the holidays to
help out with feast preparations.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}They all tease me about how girly I
am in the kitchen{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}¡Anda!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Pues me alegro!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}} Buf, a mí
me llaman siempre que hay que
preparar comida y tal.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Encima se ríen de mí porque dicen
que es algo que no pega con una
chica dura como yo{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}. ¡Qué mal!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Oooh!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Buon per te!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}} Io finisco
sempre a cucinare, quando si
tratta di festeggiare.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Mi prendono tutti in giro! Dicono
che sono molto femminile
ai fornelli{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Ooo!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Helal!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}} Bayramlarda aile
yemeğine yardım edeyim diye
beni hep eve çağırırlar. {{TAG:0003:001B:}}
Mutfakta ne kadar hanım
hanımcık olduğumla dalga
geçerler{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¡¿Qué?! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¿Sí?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}} Bueno, supongo
que hoy en día es algo normal{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Buf, es que a mí me llaman siempre
de todas partes para que eche una
mano con la comida...
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Es lo que tiene ser una cocinillas,
¡ji, ji, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¡¿Qué dices?!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Entonces{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¿solo
comes cosas precocinadas?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Con lo que se sale cocinar! ¡Es la
caña!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} A mí no hay nada que me
cargue más las pilas antes de salir.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Che?!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Cioè non hai mai cucinato{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
nemmeno un uovo al tegamino?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ma farsi da mangiare non è così
male! È divertente!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}E il cibo è molto più saporito
quando lo si prepara con le
proprie mani! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}J'ai tout d'suite pensé que ça
sentait l'embrouille, alors j'me suis
préparée au pire, mais{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}I thought they were gonna ask me to
do some nutty favor for 'em, so I
was all set to tell 'em to forget it!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Qué morro, seguro que quería
pedirme un favor de los gordos... {{TAG:0000:0004:}}Y yo ya estaba lista para decirle
que se lo pidiese a otra... En fin...
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}J'ai tout d'suite pensé qu'on allait
m'demander un truc pas très net,
alors j'étais prête à refuser, mais{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Ero convinta che mi avrebbe
chiesto qualche favore assurdo.
Ero già pronta a dire di no!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Mein grandioser Instinkt sagte mir
zuerst, dass das irgendein fieser
Trick sein muss, aber{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Kesin saçma sapan bir iyilik
isteyecek sandım; daha ağzını
açmadan 'yok' demeye hazırlanmıştım!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Claro, yo al principio pensé que me
iba a contar un secreto de estos
escabrosos, ¿sabes? {{TAG:0000:0004:}}Así que estaba intrigadísima,
ya te imaginas{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Ça sentait la révélation de secret à
l'eau de rose.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} J'en avais la nausée
rien qu'd'y penser, mais{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Ich dachte schon, dass ich mir den
neuesten Klatsch und Tratsch an-
hören muss, aber{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}They just wanted to give me a gift
from their recent trip!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} Kind of a 
weird place for that, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¡Pues en realidad solo quería
darme un detallito que me
había comprado!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Pero anda que... menudo sitio más
raro eligió para dármelo, ¿no te
parece, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Voleva solo darmi il regalo
che mi aveva comprato
nel suo ultimo viaggio!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}
Magari però non era esattamente
l'occasione giusta per farlo,
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Die Tulpe wollte mir nur 'n Ge-
schenk geben!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} Keine Ahnung, warum
das hinterm Rathaus sein musste!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Meğer son gezisinden bana
hediye getirmiş!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} Bunun için
seçtiği yer biraz tuhaftı, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}They just wanted to give my book
back to me!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} That was a weird way
to do that, though. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¡Resulta que solo quería
devolverme la batidora
que le presté!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}¡Pero anda que no había sitios
donde quedar, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}C'était juste pour m'rendre un
bouquin !{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Drôle de façon d'faire,
mais bon...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Die Tröte wollte mir einfach nur
'n Buch zurückgeben!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} Und dafür
so 'n Aufriss!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Meğer ödünç aldığı kitabımı
geri verecekmiş!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} Ama bunun için
baya tuhaf bir yöntem seçmiş. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}They just wanted to tell me about a
new hole they dug!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} What a weirdo!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¡Pues al final lo que quería era
enseñarme su nuevo peinado!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}¡Qué rarita es la gente a veces,
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}C'était juste pour me montrer un
piège récemment creusé !{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}N'importe
quoi, franchement !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Voleva solo farmi vedere l'ultima
buca che aveva scavato!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} Che
gente strana! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Die Flachzange wollte mir von dem
Loch erzählen, das die neulich erst
gebuddelt hat!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} So 'n Schmarrn!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Meğer yeni kazdığı bir çukuru
anlatacakmış!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} Ne acayip tip! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}I always look at the horoscopes in
newspapers and magazines,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} and I've
tried other methods too!
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Flower fortunes, star signs, weather
fortunes, fish fortunes,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} gyroid
fortunes{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}No matter which way I do it, the
results are the same, so it's pretty
believable!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Sí, me chifla leer el horóscopo
siempre que puedo, ¡o incluso
verlo en la tele!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Pero no solo eso{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:002B:}}También he ido
a que me lean las cartas, los posos
del café, los del té{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Supongo que se me acabará
pasando, ¡pero este mes me
ha dado muy fuerte con el tema!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}J'peux pas m'empêcher d'lire les
horoscopes des journaux et des
magazines,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} et c'est pas tout !
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Astrologie, cartomancie, entrailles
de poisson,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} gyroïdomancie{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}J'tombe globalement sur les mêmes
prévisions quelle que soit la
méthode...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Du coup j'y crois !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Leggo sempre l'oroscopo
dei quotidiani e delle riviste,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
e ho anche fatto altre prove!
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Ho imparato a leggere il futuro nei
fiori, nei segni zodiacali, nei tuoni,
nei pesci,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} nei giroidi{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Qualunque metodo utilizzi,
il risultato è sempre lo stesso.
Quindi direi che ci si può fidare!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ich les jeden Tag mein Horoskop!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Oder noch besser: {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}mein ganz
persönliches Einhorn-Horoskop!
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Meinen Kaffeesatz lese ich auch und
ich kann Sterne deuten und mit
Fischen und Gyroiden reden{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Ich muss sagen, ich hab's echt
total drauf!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Gazete ve dergilerde burçlara
hep bakarım,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} başka yöntemleri
de denedim! {{TAG:0003:002B:}}Çiçek falı, yıldız
falı, hava falı, balık falı,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
gyroid falı{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}Hangisini
yaparsam yapayım aynı sonuç
çıkıyor; demek ki bir
bildikleri var!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}If the {{TAG:0005:000C:}}
horoscope is bad in the morning, it
ruins my whole day!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}That's why I only check it at the end
of the day.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}That way if I mess something up,
I can just blame it on luck! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Pretty
smart, huh? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Pues verás, si las predicciones
para {{TAG:0005:000C:}} no son buenas
por la mañana, ¡adiós día!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Claro, por eso solo leo el horóscopo
antes de irme a dormir.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¡Y así vivo mucho más tranquila! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}
Qué ocurrente soy, ¿verdad?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Chuis {{TAG:0005:000C:}}, et l'matin, si mon
horoscope est défavorable, ma
journée est fichue !
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}J'peux pas m'empêcher d'me
comporter en fonction de c'que j'y
ai lu, tu comprends...
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Du coup j'le lis avant d'aller
m'coucher ! {{TAG:0003:0021:}}Pas bête, hein ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Se l'oroscopo {{TAG:000E:0002:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:000C:}},
il mio segno, è negativo, mi lascio
influenzare.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ecco perché lo leggo solo
alla fine della giornata!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Così, se ho combinato qualche
pasticcio, posso sempre dire che
era tutto già scritto nelle stelle!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Quanta furbizia in me, eh?
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Wenn ich morgens mein Horoskop
nicht lese, bin ich den ganzen Tag
über grantig!
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Wenn dann nämlich irgendwas
schlecht läuft, weiß ich direkt Be-
scheid! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Clever, was? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}It would be fun to be a professional
fortune-teller and read fortunes for
other people!
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}But how would I become a fortune-
teller anyway?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}I wouldn't have to take some kind
of crazy class or anything, would I?{{TAG:000B:0005:01CD}}
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}¿No crees que molaría ser una
pitonisa y saber el futuro de los
demás? ¡Sería la pera!
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Pero ¿para ser pitonisa qué
hay que hacer? ¿Alguna idea?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}¿Habrá que hacer un cursillo?
¿Ir a la universidad? Ay, ahora
estoy muy intrigada...{{TAG:000B:0005:01CD}}
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}J'aimerais trop devenir voyante
professionnelle et prédire leur
avenir aux gens !
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Mais comment faire ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}J'ai pas vraiment envie d'remettre
les pattes à l'école, moi...{{TAG:000B:0005:01CD}}
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Sarebbe divertente fare
la chiromante di professione
e leggere il futuro per gli altri!
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Ma cosa dovrei fare per diventarlo?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Non devo mica andare a vivere
in una tenda, giusto?{{TAG:000B:0005:01CD}}
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Mein großer Traum isses, als
Wahrsagerin in 'nem Wanderzirkus
durch die Welt zu touren!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ob man dafür 'ne Ausbildung
braucht?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Zertifizierte Handleserin
mit Fleißfach Tarot,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} oder so?{{TAG:000B:0005:01CD}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Profesyonel falcı olup
başkalarına fal bakmak
eğlenceli olurdu! {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Ama falcı
nasıl olunur ki?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Saçma sapan bir
kursa falan gitmem
gerekmiyordur umarım?{{TAG:000B:0005:01CD}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}The results of fortune telling are
interesting, but{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I think I'm more
into the stuff they use!
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Crystals, cards, talismans, rubber
duckies{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}} It's all so mysterious!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Whenever I pay for a fortune, I try
to note what tools are being used!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}A ver, se sale que te lean el futuro
y todas esas cosas{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} ¡pero lo que
de verdad mola es lo que usan!
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Ya sabes, cristales, cartas,
talismanes, patos de goma{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}
¡Es todo supermisterioso!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Estoy por hacerme pitonisa solo
para poder tener todas esas
cosas chulas, ¡ji, ji!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Les prévisions sont une chose,
mais{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}chuis surtout intéressée par
l'aspect technique du truc !
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Boules de cristal, cartes, talismans,
canards en plastique{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}Quel attirail
riche en mystères !
{{TAG:0003:001A:}}À chaque fois que j'vais chez la
voyante, j'fais super gaffe aux
outils qu'elle utilise,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Leggere il futuro è una cosa che
mi affascina, ma{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} a me interessano
di più quegli oggetti strani!
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Cristalli, carte, talismani, paperelle{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}
È tutto così misterioso!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Tutte le volte che mi faccio predire
il futuro, annoto gli attrezzi
che vedo, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Das Thema Esoterik kann schon
ganz schön interessant sein{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Vor
allem die ganzen Accessoires!
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Magiebücher, Froschwarzen,
alles so schön gruselig{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}} Jawoll!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Aber du behältst es doch für dich,
dass ich auf so 'nen Mumpitz stehe!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Falın sonucu ilginç ama{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}ben
daha çok kullanılan eşyalara
takılıyorum! {{TAG:0003:002B:}}Kristaller,
kartlar, tılsımlar, lastik
ördekler{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}} Hepsi çok gizemli!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}
Para verip fal baktırdığımda
hangi araçları kullandıklarına
özellikle bakıyorum! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

bateau ?!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Ah, sì?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Secondo te il treno
ti sballotta di meno di una barca?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Echt?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Im Zug wird's dir also nicht
übel?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Öyle mi?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Sence tren tekneden
daha az mı sallanıyor?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Man, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}I get motion sickness while I'm
walking sometimes{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} So I gotta be
careful what I ride on!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}I really need to take my time when
I'm planning a trip! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Buf, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}yo a veces hasta me mareo
mientras camino{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Tengo que
tener un cuidado que no veas!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Por eso tardo tanto en planificar
los viajes. ¡Qué mal, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}T'sais,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} des fois, j'ai mal au cœur
rien qu'en marchant{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} La moindre
sortie peut vite devenir un calvaire !
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}J'dois faire super attention aux
moyens d'transport quand j'prépare
un voyage,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Sai, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}ho la nausea mentre cammino
a volte{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Quindi devo stare attenta
al mezzo di trasporto che uso!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}È per questo che mi ci vuole più
tempo del normale per organizzare
un viaggio! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Vallahi {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}bazen yürürken bile
midem bulanıyor{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} O yüzden
neye bineceğime dikkat etmem
lazım! {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Seyahat planını ağır
ağır yapmalıyım! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Hi hi hi !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Toi aussi ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}On a pas d'bol,
quand même...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0024:}}D'ailleurs, c'est
surtout relou pendant les vacances !
Entre ça et l'mal du pays, tu sais
même plus c'qui t'rend malade, en
fin d'compte !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Have you heard about a connection
between ears and motion sickness,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}They say people can get sick if their
ears are too sensitive!{{TAG:000A:000B:064A004B00CD}}
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, ¿tú sabías que lo de
marearse está relacionado con
el oído y todo eso?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Al parecer, si tienes el oído muy
sensible, ¡te mareas con más
facilidad!{{TAG:000A:000B:064A004B00CD}}
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}T'as déjà entendu dire qu'y avait un
lien entre l'mal de cœur et les
oreilles ?
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Apparemment, les gens qu'ont les
esgourdes trop sensibles ont plus
souvent mal au bide que les autres...{{TAG:000A:000B:064A004B00CD}}
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Forse c'è un collegamento
tra le orecchie e la nausea da
movimento. Lo sapevi, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Insomma, dicono che chi ha
le orecchie sensibili soffra
maggiormente i mezzi di trasporto!{{TAG:000A:000B:064A004B00CD}}
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ich hab das Gerücht gehört, dass
die Ohren was mit der Reisekrank-
heit zu tun haben.
Meinste, das stimmt?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0027:}}Ob man
leichter krank wird, wenn man
große Ohren hat?{{TAG:000A:000B:064A004B00CD}}

FR:
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}J'me demande si cette sensibilité
dépend d'la taille des oreilles ?!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Si c'est l'cas, j'plains les gens
qu'ont des feuilles de chou en guise
de portugaises,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}} Mi chiedo se la dimensione
delle orecchie abbia qualcosa
a che fare con la sensibilità!?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Chissà, forse la gente con
i padiglioni auricolari più grandi,
soffre di più?! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Leute mit großen Ohren hätten
dann nichts zu lachen, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}As much as possible, don't fight
fights you can't win!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}} Pretty simple,
don't you think?
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Of course if you're protecting
someone, that's one thing{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} But
otherwise, sometimes running is OK!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Es muy fácil, el truco está en no
meterse en peleas que no se puedan
ganar.{{TAG:0003:0000:}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Si lo piensas bien, es de sentido
común, ¿no crees? {{TAG:0003:0028:}}Claro que no
todo el mundo lo tiene{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Pero bueno, si aun así la cosa se
pone fea, ¡tú sal corriendo y listo!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Y suffit de pas s'attaquer à plus
fort que soi !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}} Tu vois, c'est pas bien
compliqué.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Bon, si tu protèges quelqu'un, c'est
différent{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Mais sinon, la fuite est
parfois la meilleure solution !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Cerca di evitare il più possibile
le battaglie che sai di non poter
vincere!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}} Non è difficile, eh?
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Se stai proteggendo qualcuno, beh,
è una questione diversa{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Altrimenti,
a volte fuggire è l'unica soluzione!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Regel Nummer eins:{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Fang nie 'nen
Streit an, den du nicht gewinnen
kannst!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}} Klingt doch easy, oder?
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Regel Nummer zwei:{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Kannste
nicht gewinnen, is' es okay,
wegzurennen{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0003:0020:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Mümkünse kazanamayacağın
kavgaya girme!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}} Basit, değil mi? {{TAG:0003:0015:}}
Birini koruyorsan o ayrı{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} ama
onun dışında bazen kaçmak en iyisi!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}As much as possible, don't fight
unless you have to!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} It's that simple!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Most encounters can be settled in
the initial stare-down!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Look your opponent right in the eye,
and if you think you can't win{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}run!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Te daré un consejito: ¡evita las
peleas siempre que puedas!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} ¡No
tiene más ciencia!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Claro que siempre hay gente a la
que le gustan los líos y no se da
por vencida tan fácilmente...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Tú lo que tienes que hacer es
sopesar tus opciones, y si ves
que no puedes ganar{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} ¡huye!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Y suffit d'éviter d'se battre autant
qu'possible !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} C'est pas plus
compliqué qu'ça !
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}La plupart du temps, les disputes ne
dépassent pas le stade d'la baston
d'regards.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Fixe ton adversaire droit dans les
yeux, et si tu commences à prendre
peur{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}déguerpis !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Se puoi, non combattere nessuna
battaglia inutile!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Il concetto
mi pare semplice!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Molti scontri possono essere risolti
con un semplice sguardo!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Guarda il tuo avversario dritto
negli occhi e se pensi di non
poter vincere{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} scappa!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Hier meine goldene Regel:
Schreikrämpfe vermeiden!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Oft sagt ein eisiger Blick mehr
als tausend Schimpfworte!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Schau deinem Gegner in die
Augen.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Hält er deinem Blick
stand{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} flieh!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Mecbur değilsen kavga etme!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Bu
kadar basit!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Çoğu kavga daha ilk
bakışmada çözülür!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Karşındakinin
gözüne bak; yenemeyeceğini
anlarsan{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}kaç!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Know when to let up!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Once you've scared someone away,
there's no need to chase 'em down!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}If you do, you're just a bully!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¡Es que hay que saber tomárselo
con calma!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Lo sé por experiencia
propia.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}A las chicas duras como yo nos
cuesta dejar que nuestro rival
se largue sin llevarse su merecido...
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}¡Pero a veces es lo mejor
para no meterse en líos!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Y suffit d'savoir quand s'arrêter !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Si ton adversaire prend peur et
s'fait la malle, pas la peine d'lui
courir après !
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Si t'insistes, c'est qu't'es juste une
p'tite frappe !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Impara a capire quando è ora
di smettere!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Quando hai spaventato qualcuno,
non c'è bisogno di continuare
a inseguirlo!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Solo i bulli si comportano così!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Man muss wissen, wann
man gewonnen hat!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Haste es geschafft, deinen Gegner
zu vertreiben, bringt's nichts, dem
auch noch hinterherzujagen!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Tust du's doch, biste 'n Rüpel!{{TAG:0003:0015:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ne zaman duracağını bil!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Birini
korkutup kaçırdıysan peşine
düşmenin anlamı yok!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Yoksa
zorbanın teki olursun!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Don't break eye contact!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}Stare 'em
down, even when meeting someone
for the first time!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}If you look someone right in the eye,
you can tell if they're a threat{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}People who aren't serious threats
will usually look away, so you can
avoid a pointless dustup!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¡El quid de la cuestión es el
contacto visual!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}No bajes nunca
la mirada, ¡a la gente le da miedo!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Yo lo hago siempre, miro a mi rival
a los ojos, {{TAG:0003:0021:}}y con eso ya consigo
que se largue muerto de miedo{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}A veces te puede salir mal la jugada,
¡pero recuerda que siempre puedes
salir corriendo!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Faut jamais détourner l'regard !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}
Fixe ton adversaire, même si c'est
la première fois qu'tu l'vois !
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}C'est en scrutant les yeux de l'autre
qu'tu t'rendras compte du danger
qu'il représente{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}En général, les poules mouillées ont
vite fait d'regarder ailleurs. Et
voilà ! Une embrouille d'évitée !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Non interrompere mai il contatto
visivo!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}Costringili ad abbassare lo
sguardo, anche al primo incontro!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Guardando qualcuno negli occhi,
puoi scoprire se rappresenta
un pericolo per te{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Chi non lo è, distoglierà lo sguardo
a un certo punto... eviterai così
uno scontro inutile!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Schaut man dir in die Augen, darfste
nicht als erstes weggucken!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}Das is'
eindeutig ein Zeichen von Schwäche!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Am besten, du starrst zurück,
dann weißte auch, ob's dein
Gegner ernst meint{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Schaut er weg, dann ist er 'ne
Lusche und nicht die Mühe wert,
'nen Streit vom Zaun zu brechen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Gözünü kaçırma!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}İlk kez
tanışsan bile gözlerinin içine
bak! {{TAG:0003:0015:}}Birinin gözüne bakınca
tehdit olup olmadığını anlarsın{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ciddi olmayanlar genelde
bakışını kaçırır; boşuna kavga etmezsin!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Don't show your trump card too
early!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} It's tricky, but you can do it!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}If you've got, like, a water balloon
up your sleeve, you'll feel at ease
knowing you can use it whenever!
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Of course, you could just haul off 
and throw it at 'em at the get-go
just to be safe, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Tienes que tener siempre un as
en la manga.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Y sacarlo solo
cuando no te quede otra!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001C:}}A ver, por ejemplo, puedes llevar
escondido un globo de agua para
usarlo cuando te haga falta.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Así puedes tirarle el globo al rival
justo al principio, ¡y luego salir por
patas!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Y suffit d'garder un ou deux tours
en réserve !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} C'est pas toujours
évident, mais c'est jouable !
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Mettons que t'aies une bombe à eau
planquée dans ta veste,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}...
Tu seras {{TAG:000E:0006:0E00720061007300730075007200E9001000720061007300730075007200E9006500}} d'savoir qu'tu
peux t'en servir à tout moment, et
tu paraîtras bien plus {{TAG:000E:0006:06007300FB00720008007300FB0072006500}} de toi !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Non giocarti troppo presto l'asso
nella manica!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Non è facile,
ma ce la puoi fare!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Mettiamo che tu abbia un palloncino
pieno d'acqua nella manica. Sai di
averlo, quindi sei tranquill{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}!
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Certo, puoi sempre lanciarlo contro
gli avversari per essere al sicuro,
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Haste 'nen Trumpf im Ärmel, spiel
ihn nicht gleich aus!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Die Versuchung
mag groß sein –{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} tu's trotzdem nicht!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Haste, sagen wir,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} 'nen Wasserballon
in petto,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} kannste 'ner Konfrontation
ohne Sorge entgegentreten.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Na klar kannste den Ballon auch
direkt werfen, aber wo bleibt denn
dann der Stil? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Kozunu hemen gösterme!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Zordur
ama yapabilirsin!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Mesela kolunun
altında su balonu varsa
gerektiğinde kullanabileceğini
bilmek insanı rahatlatır! {{TAG:0003:0024:}}Gerçi
garanti olsun diye daha başta
suratına fırlatabilirsin, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Una vez escribí que de mayor
quería inventar {{TAG:000E:0001:}}
{{TAG:0005:000F:0000}}...
Quería cambiar el mundo o algo
así. ¡Qué locurón! ¡Yo no sé qué
se me pasaba por la cabeza!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Mira que no saber que era algo
que ya estaba inventado...
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¡Qué corte!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}On one page I wrote something like,
"I want to win a big, important
{{TAG:0005:0011:0000}} competition!"
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Can you imagine?{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I'm really more of
a referee or coach type, not a
serious athlete!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} What a crazy kid!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Pues por increíble que parezca,
llegué a escribir que lo mío era 
el {{TAG:0005:0011:0000}}...
¡Quería dedicarme a ello de forma
profesional! {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ji, ji, ji, qué poco me
pega...{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡Si todos sabemos que lo único
en lo que soy una profesional
es en irme de fiesta!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Y'avait ce truc : « J'veux gagner une
compète internationale de
{{TAG:0005:0011:0000}} ! »
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}T'imagines ?{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} J'tiens plus de l'arbitre
ou de l'entraîneur que d'la sportive
pro...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} J'avais pas froid aux yeux !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Su una pagina avevo scritto:
"Voglio vincere una gara importante
di {{TAG:0005:0011:0000}}!".
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ma ci pensi?{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Potrei fare l'arbitro
o l'allenatrice, ma non diventerei
mai una vera atleta!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Che follia!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Auf einer Seite steht:{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} „Liebes
Tagebuch, ich will die Weltbeste
{{TAG:000E:0008:00CD08006200650069006D00060062006500690008006200650069006D00}} {{TAG:0005:0011:0000}} sein!“
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Komm mal drauf klar!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Ich hasse
Sport!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Mann, muss ich 'ne Nerven-
säge gewesen sein!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Bir sayfaya 'Büyük ve önemli
bir {{TAG:0005:0011:0000}} yarışmasını kazanacağım!'
yazmışım! {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Düşünebiliyor musun?{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
Ben ciddi sporcu olmaktan çok
hakem ya da koç tipiyim!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ne
acayip çocukmuşum!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}On one page I wrote something like,
"I'll plan to make the very best
{{TAG:0005:0010:0000}} in the world!"
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}What is that all about?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}} I also wrote
in there somewhere that I wanted to
open a flower shop!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I was so girly!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Pues una vez escribí que el sueño
de mi vida era hacer {{TAG:000E:0008:00CD040065006C0004006C00610002003000}} mejor
{{TAG:0005:0010:0000}} del universo.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¡¿A quién se le ocurre?!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}} En fin,
también quise ser peluquera,
profesora y otras cosas...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Eso es porque aún no había
descubierto mi verdadera
vocación, ¡la fiesta!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Un giorno avevo scritto:
"Farò {{TAG:000E:0001:}}{{TAG:0005:0010:0000}}
migliore del mondo!"
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ma come mi è venuto in mente?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}
Su un'altra pagina avevo scritto
che volevo aprire un negozio di fiori!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ero troppo femminile!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Bir sayfaya 'Dünyanın en iyi {{TAG:0005:0010:0000}}
'ini yapacağım!' yazmışım! {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bu
da ne demekmiş?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}} Başka bir yerde
de çiçekçi açmak istediğimi
yazmışım!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ne hanım hanımcıkmışım!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:001A:}}By the way, I'd be so embarrassed
if anyone found that diary,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} so I just
buried it! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Buf, qué corte si alguien leyese
todas esas ñoñerías...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Menos mal
que escondí el diario, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Mi vergognerei troppo se qualcuno
trovasse quel diario,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} perciò l'ho
appena sotterrato! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Mir ist das Tagebuch so was von
peinlich, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}da hab ich es kurzerhand
irgendwo verbuddelt, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Bu arada biri günlüğü bulursa
utançtan ölürüm diye gömdüm
gitti!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Es tronchante... ¿Te puedes creer
que en el diario llamaba "mamá"
a mi madre?
¡Pero si nunca he usado una
palabra tan cursi!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} {{TAG:0003:0024:}}A mí me gustaba
más usar su nombre de pila...
Ya sabes, es como más de chica
dura y eso{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Des fois, dans l'journal, j'appelais
ma maman « Mama » alors qu'on lui
a jamais donné ce nom-là !
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}On disait simplement « Maman »,
mais faut croire que parfois,
j'rêvais d'lui donner du « Mama »{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}

{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Günlükte bazen anneme

ona hiç öyle seslenmezdik!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} {{TAG:0003:0024:}}Hep
